sum: Mrs. Shonika Prasad has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition event in Premier Explosives Limited. The filing to NSE indicates crossing of a mandatory disclosure threshold in the company's shareholding.
detail: Mrs. Shonika Prasad has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure by persons who acquire shares or voting rights in a listed company, triggering at key thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, etc.). The filing indicates an acquisition event; the specific threshold crossed and consideration structure remain to be disclosed in full in the open offer or subsequent regulatory submissions.
